mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer spending, which typically elevates corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases (SPX 20-day returns negative when both series rise).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth exceeds 105.0, it signals robust manufacturing output and business investment, leading to elevated corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.0% indicates sustained economic expansion, which typically supports positive equity market performance over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 240.0 indicates elevated inflation, which typically triggers expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing discount rates and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 240.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls and declining unemployment signals a tightening labor market, which typically boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases (SPX 20-day returns negative when both conditions hold).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 0.3 percentage points in three months), increased borrowing costs and reduced liquidity depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.3pp in three months.
